title: Do Econophysics-Inspired Inputs Improve Neural Covariance Forecasting? A Leakage-Free Walk-Forward Study of Intraday DJIA Data
abstract: arXiv:2611.27616v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Tools from econophysics, including Random Matrix Theory (RMT), Tsallis q-Gaussian tails, Hawkes self-excitation and diffusion-inspired regularization, are often proposed as ingredients for financial risk models, but their incremental value over strong contemporary benchmarks remains unclear. We introduce a Physics-Inspired Neural Covariance (PINC) framework for one-day-ahead covariance forecasting using 1-minute data from the 29 Dow Jones Industrial Average constituents over 545 trading days. The model incorporates RMT-cleaned correlations, Tsallis tail indices and Hawkes intensities as inputs and optionally includes a Fokker-Planck-inspired regularization term selected strictly on validation data. Evaluation is performed through a nested walk-forward design with 11 folds, 231 out-of-sample trading days and multiple random seeds, with explicit leakage controls and reproducibility tests. translated_title: 受经济物理学启发的输入能否改进神经网络协方差预测？基于道琼斯工业平均指数日内数据的无泄漏前向验证研究
translated_abstract: 经济物理学工具，包括随机矩阵理论（RMT）、Tsallis q-高斯尾部分布、Hawkes自激发过程以及扩散启发的正则化方法，常被提议作为金融风险模型的组成部分，但它们相对于强大的当代基准模型的增量价值仍不明确。我们提出了一个物理启发神经网络协方差（PINC）框架，用于基于道琼斯工业平均指数29个成分股在545个交易日内的1分钟数据进行提前一天协方差预测。该模型将RMT清洗后的相关性、Tsallis尾指数和Hawkes强度作为输入，并可选地包含一个严格基于验证数据选择的Fokker-Planck启发正则化项。评估采用嵌套的前向验证设计，包含11折、231个样本外交易日和多个随机种子，并实施明确的泄漏控制与可复现性测试。神经网络模型优于静态协方差估计器。
tldr: 该研究提出了融合随机矩阵理论、Tsallis尾指数和Hawkes过程等经济物理学要素的神经网络协方差预测框架（PINC），并通过严格无泄漏的前向验证设计证明了神经网络模型优于静态协方差估计方法。
en_tdlr: This study proposes a Physics-Inspired Neural Covariance (PINC) framework integrating econophysics elements such as RMT, Tsallis tail indices, and Hawkes processes, and demonstrates through a rigorous leakage-free walk-forward design that neural models outperform static covariance estimators.
